name: propersloth
description: Sean Corbett O'Donnell's Claude Code plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: parallax-threejs
plugins.description: Three.js/GLSL debugging for Claude Code — correlates scene graph, console, GL state, and pixels into one diagnosis. Plus SHA-indexed visual regression testing.

plugins.name: parallax-threejs-npm
plugins.description: Same plugin as parallax-threejs, distributed via npm instead of this git repo directly — pick this one if you'd rather install/update through the npm registry. Not usable for organization-wide distribution via Admin Settings (npm sources aren't supported there; use parallax-threejs for that). No version pinned here deliberately — the published package's own .claude-plugin/plugin.json version is authoritative and takes priority in Claude Code's resolution order, so pinning a second copy here would just be one more place for the two to silently drift apart. Resolves to whatever `npm view @propersloth/parallax-threejs dist-tags.latest` returns.

plugins.name: parallax-threejs-stable
plugins.description: Same plugin as parallax-threejs, pinned to the last deliberately-cut stable release instead of tracking main live — pick this if you want updates only when a stable version is manually released, not on every merge.
